<a id="testing-within-the-couplings--耦合之内的检验"></a>
# Testing within the couplings

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`testing-within-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](testing-within-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, and exclusion relative to a model excludes the model and the claim together. Where members respond only through their own couplings, nothing beyond the coupling closure shows within it; testing is relational.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Into a formation couple its support (whether the levels admit it), by threshold, and the levels of the conditions coupled into it by level; into the base only support couples. Two level histories are alike through its couplings at a step when the levels admit it alike and its conditions coupled in by level stand alike, and alike through them up to a step when they are so at every step up to it. (`Becoming.thresholdOnly`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThrough`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo`)
2. With every other condition coupled in alike, a condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need; one coupled in by level passes its level; the more couples in by level, the more is told apart. (`Becoming.Web.alike_of_threshold`, `Becoming.Web.observed_level_couples`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo.of_obs`)
3. A claim about level histories is excluded at a step when no history meeting it is alike with the actual one through the formation's couplings up to that step: a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, what holds is never excluded, an exclusion stands, and the more couples in by level, the more is excluded. (`Becoming.Web.Excludes`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.not_of_alike`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.not_meets`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.later`, `Becoming.Web.Excludes.widen`)
4. Without a model, for any finite prefix, neither the claim that a condition comes to nothing nor the claim that it stays above nothing afterwards is excluded. (`Becoming.Web.tail_unexcluded`)
5. Exclusion relative to a model, a class of admissible histories, is exactly exclusion of the model and the claim together; relative to a flow's balanced level histories, the actual one among them, a formation into which a stock couples by level excludes at the first step every false claim that it comes to nothing; a wrong model excludes what holds, and what couples in excludes the model. (`Becoming.Web.ExcludesWithin`, `Becoming.Web.excludesWithin_iff_conjunction`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancedHistory`, `Becoming.Flow.excludes_tail_within`, `Becoming.Stationary.model_error`, `Becoming.Stationary.model_excluded`)
6. The class alike through a formation's couplings is the histories alike with the actual one through them; exclusion is a claim disjoint from that class; a judgment made through the couplings is exactly a common response of the judging process of Becoming.Inquiry over the class, kept as later steps and more coupling narrow it. (`Becoming.Web.ClassThrough`, `Becoming.Web.class_excludes_iff`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_iff`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_later`, `Becoming.Web.class_judge_widen`)
7. A condition couples into a formation when the formation depends on it or it couples in by level; the coupling closure is the closure under being affected through what couples in, holding the influence closure, equal to it where only support couples in, and growing with coupling by level and with exchange. (`Becoming.Web.CoupledInto`, `Becoming.Flow.CoupledFrom`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinCoupling`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_of_withinInfluence`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_thresholdOnly`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_mono_obs`, `Becoming.Flow.withinCoupling_mono_flow`)
8. For two flows with the same formations present, balancing at each step on every condition coupled into a member of a region, the region closed in both under being affected through what couples in, the levels starting alike on what couples into members, and each member taking from and giving to what couples into members alike wherever the flows have been alike through its couplings, the flows are alike through every member's couplings at every step. (`Becoming.Flow.alike_within_closed`)
9. With the rest of the exchange fixed and balance at each step on what couples in within the closure, the worlds with and without a part whose members all lie beyond the coupling closure are alike through the couplings within it at every step; no claim met by the levels without it is excluded there; an exclusion there relative to a model rests on the model excluding its exchange; a judgment there is admissible with and without it. (`Becoming.Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence`, `Becoming.Flow.unexcluded_beyond_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.beyond_needs_model`, `Becoming.Flow.class_judge_beyond`)
10. In Clearing the worlds are alike through the clearer's couplings at every step whether or not its clearing ends the dweller; with the habitat spared, the claim that the dweller is ended is excluded by the clearer at no step and by the dweller at the third step; the claim that the dweller or the clearer is not admitted at the third step is excluded by neither alone and by the two together. (`Becoming.Clearing.alike_for_clearer`, `Becoming.Clearing.DwellerEnded`, `Becoming.Clearing.tested_by_dweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.EitherEnded`, `Becoming.Web.ExcludesBy`, `Becoming.Clearing.pooled`)
11. With a model fixing the start and the exchange, the clearer excludes at the first step what does not couple into it. (`Becoming.Clearing.FixedStartAndExchange`, `Becoming.Clearing.model_idles_coupling`)
12. In Prey, the prey not depending on itself, the predator lies beyond its influence closure and within its coupling closure under a gauge of itself: the worlds with and without the predator's part are alike through the prey's support at every step, and the gauge passes the taking after the bite; this rests on omitted relations. (`Becoming.ownStanding`, `Becoming.Prey.couples_taking`, `Becoming.Prey.omits`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The definitions of coupling and exclusion assume nothing; a model is a supplied class of admissible histories.
- Balance is assumed only on the conditions coupled in, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.
- Flow.alike_within_closed further assumes the region closed in both flows, the starts alike, and the members responding only through their own couplings, all supplied: how others respond is supplied. The comparison with and without a part uses withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels, the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation); a part is a decided family of formations.
- Coupling: support and the levels of the conditions coupled in by level (obs, a parameter); activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as coupled in. Exclusion is by one formation, at a step, under one level history; a claim is any proposition about level histories.
- Whether a formation's own standing counts as coupled in (Ren's question 4, asked then as whether it is registered) was decided by the AI after exploring the options: only support couples into the base (thresholdOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing couples in by threshold through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing); a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is a premise of coupling by level. The reasons are in the integration note.
- For the witnesses: their flows, webs and models (Clearing, Prey, Stationary).
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Each feedback blindness holds only in its scope: below threshold where exchange follows what couples in, beyond the horizon where continuation is open, beyond the coupling closure where members respond only through their own couplings.
- The laws do not derive that anything beyond its support couples into a formation by level, that it forms a model, wants to test or knows its coupling closure.
- Being alike through the couplings bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.
- What an act does compares two histories and is testable only relative to a model of the history without it; varying one's own act and the difference showing through the couplings (experiment) is not stated here.
- **Counterexample:** Exclusion relative to a model can err: in Stationary the model says nothing takes or gives, and relative to it a formation gauging the stock excludes at the first step the claim that the stock comes to nothing, which holds of the actual history (Stationary.model_error). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The coupling closure can be strictly larger than the influence closure: in Prey the predator lies beyond the prey's influence closure and, under a gauge of itself, within its coupling closure (Prey.couples_taking); the difference coupled in does nothing to the prey, which does not bear on itself (Prey.omits), so the witness rests on omitted relations. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (a does-not-show item states it); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理, read by the AI as a model answerable to registration, is now read as Ren read it on 12 October 2026, the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; a model is still tested only through what couples in (generalization-through-lumping). So the readings here are the AI's narrowed ones, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D26), not the wording Ren accepted.
